metadata.question: Does vegetation cover increase in the Taklamakan Desert near Hotan from February 23, 2020 to April 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about vegetation cover increase in the Taklamakan Desert near Hotan between February 23, 2020 and April 29, 2020. 1. Search strategy: - Location: Taklamakan Desert near Hotan (I'll use coordinates for Hotan: ~37.1°N, 79.9°E) - Time period: February 23, 2020 to April 29, 2020 - Data: Sentinel-2 is good for vegetation monitoring with NDVI - Need to compare vegetation at start vs end of period 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds for accurate NDVI calculation - Use Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for early period (Feb 23 ± a few days) - Calculate mean NDVI for late period (Apr 29 ± a few days) - Compare if late period NDVI > early period NDVI - Check for valid data and pixels Let me structure the code: - Define geometry around Hotan - Get Sentinel-2 collections for both time periods - Calculate NDVI and mask clouds - Check if collections have data - Check if valid pixels exist - Compare mean NDVI values - Validate results ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const hotan = ee.Geometry.Point([79.9, 37.1]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Hotan const earlyStart = '2020-02-20'; const earlyEnd = '2020-02-26'; const lateStart = '2020-04-26'; const lateEnd = '2020-05-02'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 function getS2Collection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(hotan) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); } // Cloud masking function function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // NDVI calculation function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // Get collections const earlyCol = getS2Collection(earlyStart, earlyEnd).map(maskS2clouds).map(addNDVI); const lateCol = getS2Collection(lateStart, lateEnd).map(maskS2clouds).map(addNDVI); // Check collection sizes const earlySize = earlyCol.size().getInfo(); const lateSize = lateCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Early period images: ${earlySize}`); console.log(`Late period images: ${lateSize}`); if (earlySize === 0 || lateSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create composites and calculate mean NDVI const earlyComposite = earlyCol.median().select('NDVI'); const lateComposite = lateCol.median().select('NDVI'); // Check valid pixels const earlyCount = earlyComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hotan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const lateCount = lateComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hotan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Early valid pixels: ${earlyCount}`); console.log(`Late valid pixels: ${lateCount}`); if (earlyCount === 0 || lateCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI const earlyNDVI = earlyComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hotan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const lateNDVI = lateComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hotan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Early NDVI: ${earlyNDVI ? earlyNDVI.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Late NDVI: ${lateNDVI ? lateNDVI.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); // Validation & Final Answer if (earlyNDVI === null || lateNDVI === null || isNaN(earlyNDVI) || isNaN(lateNDVI) || earlyNDVI > 1 || lateNDVI > 1 || earlyNDVI < -1 || lateNDVI < -1) { console.log("C3"); } else if (lateNDVI > earlyNDVI) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
